name: plan
description: Break down work into ordered, implementable tasks using planning-and-task-breakdown skill

steps.prompt: Load the planning-and-task-breakdown skill. Read the current spec or requirements from docs/spec/ or user input: {{input}}
Break the work into small, independent tasks. Each task should be: one clear deliverable, estimable (hours not days), independently testable, ordered by dependencies
Write the plan to docs/plan/ directory. Include task list, dependencies, estimated effort, and test strategy per task
